items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: That's what happened to Lynn's mouth, I got a little mutt, you know.

ctx.x: He chewed up a $7 shirt, the other day he chewed up another $7 shirt.
That's what happened to Lynn's mouth, I got a little mutt, you know. Yeah. They tore down all the sheets and the pillowcases and all that.
I told you, they all do it. He can't leave clothes on the line with his dogs. They like to eat them up.
